Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Industrial Coffee Table with Multisquare Wood Design, 47.24"W
Colors: Natural/Golden
Materials: Metal
The multisquare wooden plank tabletop creates a natural and textured look that will catch the eye in any space. A bronze frame creates a sturdy base, stable enough for this piece to work wherever you need storage. This unique piece comes fully assembled and has easy care, making it a must-have addition. 47.24"W x 25.59"D x 15.75"H Tabletop made with unique multisquare wood parquetry design inset in a metal base This coffee table is a mix of modern aesthetics and traditional craftwork. The bronze frame has clean lines and modern styling. Fully assembled table No assembly required Clean with a soft, damp cloth. Avoid placing furniture near heat vents or open windows. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
